title: A final law is not satisfied through an admit its boundary allows (reason assumption, blocking), while the same proof establishes the law at critical

assert.why: A.7.5.1 rule 9: tier final uses critical's policy, which blocks unestablished

the admit is a declared assumption for a non-final law
